phase_name: Migrate the Remaining Lint Cluster Members

objectives.description: Migrate the four remaining wrapper-carrying lints onto lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh
objectives.note: Deviation: direct inspection found only lint-scoped-commit-boundary.sh carries the literal byte-identical wrapper. lint-shellcheck.sh migrated partially (fast-path + explicit-path branches; its git-ls-files middle branch stays by design). lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh and lint-hook-registration-paths.sh are reasoned exclusions (see plan Phase 5 Reasoned Exclusions table) -- each carries a materially different pattern-matching contract.

objectives.description: Extend lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh with the wider shared skeleton and migrate lint-branch-gated-sections.sh onto it
objectives.note: Added lint_corpus_scan_parse_flags (shared --verbose/--quiet/positional-scan-paths loop, byte-identical across all seven cluster members) and applied it to 5 of 7 files (the two files this phase did not otherwise touch, lint-directory-pathspec-boundary.sh and lint-state-writer-boundary.sh, are outside this phase's declared file scope). VIOLATIONS accounting and exit-code-convention summary sections were evaluated and NOT extracted -- each lint's summary carries distinct metric names/categories, so a generic formatter would be net-neutral-to-positive, not net-negative.

objectives.description: Delete per-file duplicated comment blocks explaining the shared skeleton
objectives.note: Each migrated wrapper's travelling 7-line Phase-9 comment was deleted along with the wrapper block it explained, as part of objectives 1-2's edits.

objectives.description: Diff each of the seven lints' finding output over the whole corpus before and after
objectives.note: Captured stdout/stderr for all seven lints before any edit; diffed after each edit. All byte-identical (empty diff) for the five touched files.

objectives.description: Re-confirm gate registry rows for gates 12,17,18,19,21,22,23
objectives.note: grep of verify-deploy.sh's gate bodies confirms unchanged script paths and --verbose invocation shape. Ran verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 12,17,18,19,21,22,23 against the redeployed tree: 7 checks, 0 failures.

objectives.description: Extend test-lint-corpus-scan-lib.sh and record the phase's NET-PROD/NET-TEST deltas
objectives.note: Added single-definition assertions for both lib functions, a widened-fast-path-guard case, lint_corpus_scan_parse_flags functional/usage-error cases, and an updated migrated-caller inventory (17 passed, 0 failed). Recorded NET-PROD -6, NET-TEST +97 in the plan's Phase 5 closing note and Running Net Figures section.

approaches_tried.approach: Force all four remaining wrapper-carrying lints through lint_corpus_scan_collect_files as literally planned
approaches_tried.reason: Direct inspection of lint-task-lookup-adoption.sh and lint-hook-registration-paths.sh showed each carries a materially different pattern-matching contract the lib's flat single-pattern-set FILES array cannot safely replicate; reverted to a reasoned exclusion instead.
